paper_title: On Memory, Communication, and Synchronous Schedulers When Moving and Computing
statement: Another open problem is whether there exists a scheduler S 0 (“weaker” than Fsynch but stronger than Ssynch) such that each model under S 0 would be computationally equivalent to the same model under Fsynch. Finally, most of the results of this paper hold assuming chirality and rigidity (exceptions are the RDV-algorithms, the OSP-algorithms, and the simulation algorithm, Algorithm 1, which do not require either). It is an open question to characterize the inclusions among all the various models in the case of disoriented robots with non-rigid movement.
